# Perspective AI

Perspective AI is an open-source platform by AOSSIE designed to combat echo chambers and algorithmic confirmation bias by generating structured, credible counter-perspectives for online articles.

---

## 📂 Project Architecture

- **`app/[locale]/`**: Localized dynamic route group. All pages and layouts live here.
- **`app/[locale]/page.tsx`**: Main landing page with 3D WebGL Globe, preset trending topics, and article analysis input.
- **`app/[locale]/impact/`**: Measurable impact statistics and real-world media literacy applications.
- **`app/[locale]/contribute/`**: Open-source developer onboarding and contribution guidelines.
- **`app/[locale]/about/`**: Mission statement and multi-agent AI pipeline architecture.
- **`app/[locale]/contact/`**: Community feedback channels (Discord, GitHub).
- **`app/[locale]/analyze/`**: Article URL submission, loading progress, and structured result scorecard with RAG chat.
- **`public/brand/`**: Repository branding folder containing logos, favicon, and brand specifications (`Brand.md`).
- **`config/languages.ts`**: Supported locales configuration list (`en`, `hi`).
- **`messages/`**: Translation catalogs (`en.json`, `hi.json`).

---

## 🎨 Theme & Style System
- Built with Tailwind CSS and Next-Themes.
- Semantic CSS variables in `globals.css` provide Deep Navy Blue for dark mode and Warm Biscuit Cream for light mode.

---

## 📦 Build Commands
- **Build:** `npm run build`
- **Develop:** `npm run dev`
